IMO STATE (PSI 8.8): Governor Hope Uzodimma Commends Security Agencies Following Rescue of 20 Abducted NYSC Corps Members

EDO STATE (PSI 8.5): Edo Plans ₦250B GRA Infrastructure Renewal; Inspects Gully Threat to Power Transmission Tower
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 8.4): Governor Namadi Attends Nigeria–Ethiopia Forum; Commences Hadejia Road Maintenance
EBONYI STATE (PSI 8.2): Governor Nwifuru Pledges WAEC Sponsorship for 199 Students and Grants Ph.D. Scholarship
DELTA STATE (PSI 8.1): Governor Oborevwori Inspects Facilities for Army Air Defence Regiment Deployment
KEBBI STATE (PSI 8.0): Governor Idris Conducts Security Assessment in Sakaba; Establishes Forward Operating Base
ANAMBRA STATE (PSI 7.9): Anambra Scores 100% in Open Government Partnership Subnational Assessment
RIVERS STATE (PSI 7.8): Rivers Government Drives Youth Recruitment for 92 Regular Army Intake
GOMBE STATE (PSI 7.7): Governor Inuwa Yahaya Hosts Live Media Chat; NEDC Distributes Learning Materials to 670 Students
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 7.5): Zamfara Ministry of Commerce Engages Non-Indigene Community for Business Expansion
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 7.2): Governor Umo Eno Meets Student Leaders; Announces Annual Transition Conference
EKITI STATE (PSI 7.0): Ekiti Inaugurates Food and Nutrition Committees Across All 16 LGAs
OYO STATE (PSI 6.8): Governor Seyi Makinde Holds Strategic Dialogue with EU Ambassador and 16 EU Envoys
KATSINA (PSI 9.1): Revealed monthly IGR growth to ₦3B+ and debt reduction to ₦14B at World Bank event; partnered with NIMC to build a joint Technical Working Group for identity integration.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.0): Gifting electric vehicles to NLC/TUC/NUT leaders; Assembly passed Tree Crops Development Agency Bill; reviewed Social Protection Policy; shut 9 unapproved schools.
LAGOS (PSI 8.9): Repurposed former CACOVID center for LASUCOM medical student training expansion; distributed MICHD nutrition packs in Ojo; LAWMA resolved 1,291 Q3 waste complaints.
IMO (PSI 8.8): Gov Uzodimma commended security gallantry following successful rescue of 20 abducted prospective NYSC Corps Members along Onitsha–Owerri Road.
ONDO (PSI 8.7): ODCHC recorded 12,949 new health insurance enrollees in Q2 2026 driven by retiree access; sustained zero maternal mortality under Abiyamo Scheme across 568 deliveries.
EDO (PSI 8.5): Announced ₦250B GRA flood rehabilitation plan; approved 33 vehicles for judges; inspected severe gully erosion site threatening a 32KVA power transmission tower.
JIGAWA (PSI 8.4): Gov Namadi joined VP Shettima in Addis Ababa for Nigeria-Ethiopia Nutrition Exchange Forum; officially commenced budget-funded road maintenance in Hadejia.
EBONYI (PSI 8.2): Gov Nwifuru visited CSS Nwofe Agbaja, pledging state sponsorship of WAEC fees for 199 students and granting an automatic Ph.D. scholarship to Miss Treasure Ogbuinya.
DELTA (PSI 8.1): Gov Oborevwori inspected facility preparation for the 83 Division Air Defence Regiment, expecting 300-400 incoming troops to protect critical energy assets.
KEBBI (PSI 8.0): Gov Idris visited Sakaba LGA following security incidents, establishing a Forward Operating Base, upgrading Zuru Barracks, and deploying operational vehicles.
ANAMBRA (PSI 7.9): Achieved a perfect 100% score in Open Government Partnership (OGP) Nigeria Subnational Assessment, affirming state fiscal disclosure and citizen participation.
RIVERS (PSI 7.8): SSG Dr. Dagogo Wokoma hosted Army Headquarters envoys, monarchs, and youth leaders across 23 LGAs to ensure full utilization of the state's military quota.
GOMBE (PSI 7.7): Gov Inuwa Yahaya hosted a live 90-minute broadcast media chat on 30th anniversary; NEDC donated learning materials to 670 students at Idi JSS.
ZAMFARA (PSI 7.5): Commerce Ministry engaged Non-Indigene Community leaders, promising land allocation and business incentives aligned with Gusau International Airport.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 7.2): Gov Umo Eno hosted state student leaders, announcing plans for a multi-stakeholder student transition conference and elevating his PA on Student Affairs.
EKITI (PSI 7.0): Inaugurated Local Government Committees on Food and Nutrition (LGCFN) in all 16 LGAs with UNICEF support to tackle malnutrition at the grassroots.
OYO (PSI 6.8): Gov Seyi Makinde met in Abuja with EU Ambassador Gautier Mignot and 16 member state envoys to discuss international development cooperation.
